description: This file contains integration tests for the OrderController in an ASP.NET Core web application. It uses xUnit as the testing framework and tests various scenarios of the Order controller, including handling of order details retrieval. It also sets up a mock authentication handler to simulate an authenticated user and a mocked IMediator for testing mediator-based interactions.

classes.name: OrderControllerTests
classes.description: Test class for OrderController, uses WebApplicationFactory to create test server instances with mock authentication and mediator responses.

classes.name: TestAuthHandlerOptions
classes.description: Options class for the custom test authentication scheme.

classes.name: TestAuthHandler
classes.description: Custom authentication handler that automatically authenticates users with predefined claims for testing purposes.

methods.name: AuthenticatedFactoryWithMediator
methods.description: Creates a WebApplicationFactory with a mocked IMediator that returns a specified response, used to simulate different scenarios for order details.

methods.name: Detail_ReturnsBadRequest_WhenOrderNotFound
methods.description: Test method that verifies the API returns BadRequest when the order is not found.

methods.name: Detail_ReturnsOk_WhenOrderExists
methods.description: Test method that verifies the API returns OK when the order exists and is retrieved successfully.
